description: Native OS floors, orientation, plugin, privacy, and signing metadata that Capacitor's shared config cannot express. Applied to the generated ios/App and android projects; read by scripts/native/validate-projects.mjs. No secrets are tracked here.

App.notes: Foreground/background + resume lifecycle events; state changes are de-duplicated in runtimeEvents native adapter.

Network.notes: Connectivity change listener attached early in bootstrap.

Preferences.notes: Non-secret device-id and lightweight settings storage.

SecureStorage.notes: Auth token storage backed by iOS Keychain / Android Keystore.

ScreenOrientation.notes: Locks to landscape during shell.prepare() before input is enabled.

StatusBar.notes: Hidden during shell.prepare() before input is enabled.

SplashScreen.notes: launchAutoHide is false; the app hides the splash once after readiness.

dataCategories.notes: Username and best-score progress persisted to the game backend.
An app-generated device id kept in Preferences; not an ad identifier.

signing.notes: No signing material is tracked. Release signing is supplied at build time from environment/CI only.
